headline: Kejriwal ka formula: Punjab jeeto toh janta, Delhi haaro toh Vote Chor
caption:

Haar pe system ganda, jeet pe system sahi? 🤦
Apne us dost ko bhejo jo har haar pe EVM ko blame karta hai 😂

Follow @khabarbawaal for daily updates.

#reelsindia #Kejriwal #AAP #politicalmemes #IndianPolitics
pin_comment: Punjab 2022: AAP 92/117. Delhi 2025: AAP 22/70. Same Election Commission. Aapko kya lagta hai?

issues: Caption: The caption and slide 3 say Punjab 2022 was won under "isi EC" or "isi Election Commission". Gyanesh Kumar became CEC in Feb 2025, so he was not CEC for the 2022 Punjab election or the Feb 2025 Delhi election. It is the same institution but a different CEC. Consider wording it as "Election Commission" in general, not as the same EC under Gyanesh Kumar.

Slide 4: "Delhi mein EC chor" states the theft claim as fact. Kejriwal's "vote thief" quote was aimed at CEC Gyanesh Kumar and was an allegation. Consider attributing it, for example as Kejriwal's claim, or framing it clearly as satire.

Slide 1: The photo is a generic film still of a distressed person. It has no visible link to Kejriwal or the story, and the credit for the image is not given. It is the cover slide, so it cannot be dropped. Consider a relevant image.

headline: Purported CJP Protesters' WhatsApp Chat Screenshot Shows 'Kasab Energy' Message Before Delhi Protest
caption:

Isme ek bande ka message 'Kasab energy' wala bataya ja raha hai.
Screenshot purported hai, abhi iski independent confirmation nahi hai.
Screenshot asli hai to 🔥, fake hai to 🤡

Follow @khabarbawaal for daily updates.
Source: Inshorts - Stay Informed (link pinned in comments 👇)

#viral #trending #india #delhi #politics
pin_comment: Sabse bada sawal: ye chat leak kaise hua? Screenshot ki sach-jhooth jaanch hone tak ek pinch of salt zaroor lena 🧂

issues: Slide 1: The cover photo looks like the well-known CCTV image of Ajmal Kasab running at CST station during the 26/11 attack. It sits beside the chat screenshot and the headline about the CJP protesters. That visually equates the protesters with the terrorist, although the story only says the screenshot is unverified. It also risks defaming the protesters and misleading readers. Use a neutral image, such as the protest or the News18 tweet, or clearly label this photo as a file photo of Kasab. I could not check the article, so I can't confirm the photo's source.

Slide 4: The caption says the photo shows barricade pushing and shoving at the Delhi protest. I could not check this against the article. Confirm the photo is from this protest and not from an earlier, unrelated one. The slide links it to the Supreme Court remark from News18, which is a separate point.

Caption: I couldn't check the article, so I couldn't confirm the names Dipke and Ranka, the detention, or the expansion of 'CJP' as 'Cockroach Janta Party'. Verify these against the source. The Dipke/Ranka slide and the Supreme Court remark are not mentioned in the caption.
